blocks.text: Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson continues to help Filipino communities get closer to meeting the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) adopted by the United Nations. The pharmacist from Davao, the Philippines’ delegate to the 2026 Miss International pageant in Japan later this year, took part in a recent livelihood session with the women of Barangay Karuhatan in Valenzuela City. “Inclusion means making sure opportunities are within reach,” Johnson said of the learning session conducted by Tesda (Technical Education and Skills Development Authority), the government’s primary agency for technical-vocational education and training.
